contract: Select at most one video, audio and subtitle track by container track ID. Fold only delivered packets.
In the reference set the discard policy on unselected streams. The switch case reads a packet prefix, seeks backward on video and selects the other audio track.

open_deviations.reading: Selected Matroska AVC keeps the exact frame duration
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 section 5.1.4.1.13 expresses DefaultDuration in nanoseconds.
open_deviations.candidate: Keeps DefaultDuration at native precision, for example 41666666 ns.
open_deviations.reference: Publishes 41000000 ns on the corresponding packets in its millisecond clock.
open_deviations.compat: compat::matroska::demux_packet_duration for consumers needing the reference millisecond durations.

open_deviations.reading: Matroska AAC selection keeps the source clock, including after an audio switch
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 sections 5.1.4.1.25 and 11.2 subtract nanosecond CodecDelay from the exact Block presentation timestamp. RFC 9559 section 5.1.4.1.13 expresses DefaultDuration in nanoseconds.
open_deviations.candidate: Keeps DTS absent. First AAC PTS is -21333333 ns with duration 21333333 ns and the switch keeps the new track’s -23219955 ns delay.
open_deviations.reference: Fills AAC DTS from PTS. First AAC PTS is -21000000 ns with duration 21000000 ns and AAC times after the switch are on its millisecond grid.
open_deviations.compat: compat::matroska::demux_packet_clocks for consumers using the reference DTS fill-in and duration quantization.
